thread:
alex: Quick sync — monthly incident patterns digest. Pulled postmortems, alerts, and paging logs from the last 6 months. TL;DR: 4 recurring signatures are responsible for ~68% of P1/P2 impact.

maria: link: https://redwood-internal/incident-digest-6mo :eyes:

kevin: Nice. Can you paste the proposed ownership matrix here so we can assign?

alex: pasted below. this is intentionally short — want ownership + realistic due dates.

alex: ```
Signature | Symptom | Proposed owner | Priority | Due
capacity-saturation | tail lat spikes + throttles | @kevin | P0 | 2026-04-15
kv-cache-staleness | stale prefixes, elevated error rate | @maria | P1 | 2026-05-01
model-oom | OOMs during long ctx generations | @elaine | P0 | 2026-04-10
routing-fallback | unexpected fallback to smaller model | @shar | P2 | 2026-06-01
```

shar: I can take routing-fallback but need a small infra change (LRU eviction tweak + health check). estimate 3 dev days.

kevin: capacity-saturation — short term: raise burst pool + revise autoscale thresholds. long term: autoscaler rewrite (split policy). I'll own short term, but need eng-infra on the long term.

maria: kv-cache-staleness — we should add a TTL-based reconciliation job and alert on cache hit divergence. I'll set up proof-of-concept this sprint.

elaine: model-oom — tracking: two offending model versions (v2.1 / v2.2) with long sequences. short fix = version pin + quantized variant for long-ctx. I'll submit rollout plan by EOD Fri.

alex: Proposed deliverables (short):
- kevin: autoscale threshold bump + rollout plan (2026-04-15)
- maria: reconciliation job + test harness (2026-05-01)
- elaine: version pin + quantized rollout (2026-04-10)
- shar: LRU tweak + healthcheck (2026-05-01)

ops-bot: Action tracker updated: https://redwood-internal/actions/2163456789 (4 open items) :white_check_mark:

maria: small ask — can we mark owners as primary/backup? I can be backup for routing if needed.

kevin: backup: @maria for capacity during oncall gaps. noted.

shar: question on priority: model-oom and capacity both P0 — do we want to sequence them?

alex: good point. sequence = model-oom (eliminate immediate customer impact), then capacity short-term, then kv-cache and routing.

elaine: i can accelerate if we need — will aim for 2026-04-08 for the rollout plan.

kevin: will do threshold bump this afternoon and post rollout notes.

alex: OK — follow-up: weekly quick-check thread. owners, paste progress updates as replies. next sync standup Wed 10:00am PST. If you can't make it, post updates in-thread.

elaine: ack, will post plan by 2026-04-08.
